# To Henesys, the Prairie Town

Mentally exhausted from endless adventuring, a peaceful rest sounds pretty good right now.

To Henesys, the Prairie Town
Citizenship
Self-Starting
Pre-requisites
Level Lv. 12+
Rewards
321 EXP 351 Mesos
Red Potion x 5 Blue Potion x 5
Description
01 Mentally exhausted from endless adventuring, a peaceful rest sounds pretty good right now.
Quest journal 03 ⌄ 02 It seems Henesys offers various services for adventurers. I should drop by Henesys if I'm ever in the area.
03 Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
04 Arthur, the Town Clerk I met at Henesys Town Hall, suggested I become a resident of Henesys. Once I've made up my mind, I should speak with Arthur for more details.
NPC Dialogue
On accept
Adventuring is great, but sometimes I just want to take a break. Since it's on my mind, maybe I'll swing by Henesys Town Hall ?
If you accept
If I want to learn more about Henesys , going to the Town Hall seems like the best bet. I should drop by when I have some time.
If you decline
No, I'd rather focus on adventuring for now.
On completion
Welcome to Henesys ! Adventurers are always more than welcome here. Now that you're here, would you mind if I made a special proposal?
A long time ago, wandering archers gathered one by one to found Henesys . Today, Chief Chief Stan and the archer instructor Athena Pierce serve as our dependable pillars.
Vast prairies, warm weather, and friendly neighbors... I honestly think Henesys is the absolute definition of a wonderful place to live.
That's why Henesys recently decided to offer adventurers the chance to become official residents , so more people can settle down here! Wonderful, isn't it?
If you ever become interested in obtaining Henesys Citizenship , please feel free to speak with me anytime!
